attributeDescription: Inactive listings are not available for buyers on Makro
Regions where buyers can order the product from
Brand is the name of the company under which the product is marketed and sold.
Height refers to the measurement from top to base or head to foot of the trimmer.
qualifierDescription: Height - Measuring Unit refers to the unit used to measure the height. Units should be filled only in singular form.

attributeDescription: Number of Length Adjustments refers to the number of length settings available in the trimmer.

Brand Colour refers to the shade of the product. Sometimes it can be a name derived from only alphabets or it can be alphanumeric as well. The value 'Multicolour' should be used if the product has 3 or more prominent colours on the product.

Warranty Service Type refers to the process that must be followed by the customer to claim warranty. This can include details regarding point of contact or other relevant details that would be useful for the customer if the product malfunctions. It can also include details regarding the way in which the customer's request will be processed; either by sending a service engineer or requesting the customer to take the product to a specified Service Center, etc.
Body Material refers to the substance used to make the body of the trimmer.
Battery Run Time refers to how long a battery charge will last while using the trimmer.
qualifierDescription: Battery Run Time - Measuring Unit refers to the unit used to measure the battery run time. Units should be filled only in singular form.

attributeDescription: Suitable For refers to the various kinds of grooming for which the trimmer is suitable.
allowedValues: Beard & Moustache||Bikini Area||Body Grooming||Hair Clipping||Nose, Ear & Eyebrow

attributeDescription: Search Keywords refers to the words which the customer might use to find a product. These keywords are tagged to the product and when the buyer searches with the appropriate search word(s), the nearest appropriate product is retrieved and displayed on Makro website. The search output is also based on multiple other factors such as Product Quality, Pricing, etc. Please enter a maximum of 5 keywords for this purpose.
Features refers to the distinctive characteristics of the trimmer.
allowedValues: Adjustable Trimming Range||Detachable Head||Easy to Clean||Non-Allergic||Rechargeable

attributeDescription: Cord Length refers to the length of the power cord. Please ensure that the values entered are in Metres.
qualifierDescription: Cord Length - Measuring Unit refers to the unit used to measure the distance from the appliance to the power outlet. Units should be filled only in singular form.

attributeDescription: Packaging Type specifies the packaging type of the product.
Weight refers to the weight of the trimmer only, without packaging.
qualifierDescription: Weight - Measuring Unit refers to the unit used to measure the weight. Units should be filled only in singular form.

attributeDescription: Waterproof Ratings refers to the international standard that the product is ideal to use on the water.
Please write few lines describing your product. Description is limited to 5000 characters (including spaces). It should not include any hyperlinks, additional offers, or promotion text.
exampleValue: The Philips MG3750 Beard Trimmer offers precise trimming with skin-friendly blades. Its cordless design and long battery life make it convenient for grooming on the go. The washable head ensures easy cleaning after use.

attributeDescription: Display Type refers to the type of digital display on the trimmer.
Power Source refers to the source of power for the trimmer.
Charging Time refers to the total time required by the trimmer's battery to be fully charged.
qualifierDescription: Charging Time - Measuring Unit refers to the unit used to measure the charging time. Units should be filled only in singular form.

attributeDescription: Colour refers to the shade of the product as mentioned by the brand on the label or salespackage. The value 'Multicolour' should be used if the product has a mix of colours that is 3 or more prominent colours on the product.
Power Requirement refers to the voltage (V) and frequency (Hz) rating of the trimmer.
Type refers to whether the product can be used with or without a power cord.
Battery Type refers to the type of battery used to power the trimmer.

Trimming Range refers to the level of grooming that can achieved using the trimmer. Please ensure that values entered are in a range and are separated by '-'. Also, ensure that the values entered are in Millimeters.

attributeDescription: Other Power Features refers to any additional information on the power features of the trimmer that would be useful to a customer.
Other Features refers to any additional information on the features of the trimmer that would be useful to a customer.
EAN refers to the 13 digits unique bar code given to each product which is universally recognizable.
Model Number refers to the number assigned by the manufacturers to identify the different trimmers that they offer.
Ideal For refers to the gender the trimmer is most suitable for.
Blade Material refers to the substance used to make the blade of the trimmer.
Width refers to the breadth, broadness or wideness of the trimmer.
qualifierDescription: Width - Measuring Unit refers to the unit used to measure the width. Units should be filled only in singular form.

attributeDescription: Warranty Summary refers to a brief description on the warranty details of the product. This is mostly one-lined information, which should compulsorily include the number of years covered in warranty and type of warranty (domestic or international).
Batteries Included refers to whether or not the trimmer comes with batteries.
Water Resistant refers whether or not the trimmer is resistant towards water.
Power Consumption refers to the amount of electric power consumed by the trimmer.
qualifierDescription: Power Consumption - Measuring Unit refers to the unit used to measure the power consumption. Units should be filled only in singular form.

attributeDescription: Sales Package refers to the information of all the contents that are sold in the package. Please specify the package information along with the number of each content mentioned before the name. Data should be double pipe (||) separated.
Number of Batteries refers to the number of batteries required to make the trimmer functional.

Trimmer Type refers to the classification of the product based on the number of heads available as part of the sales package. If the sales package consists only of a trimmer head with multiple combs, the type value should be filled as Trimmer. If the sales package consists of a trimmer head along with a shaver head, nose hair trimmer, clipper head, etc, the type Grooming Kit should be selected.
Care Instructions refers to the directions to be followed with respect to taking care of the product.
exampleValue: Clean with a brush and rinse under running water
